messages:
sam: quick flag — new edge sample (vite + esbuild) errors out with TS: "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'" after `npm i @redwood/inference`.

jordan: ugh. that sounds like an exports map/types mismatch. can you paste the installed package.json exports from node_modules?

sam: pasted from node_modules/@redwood/inference/package.json: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./runtime": {
    "edge": "dist/edge.mjs"
  }
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```

lee: two likely root causes: 1) some resolvers only look inside the conditional exports for a types pointer rather than the top-level "types" field; 2) edge/bundler resolution picks the "edge" branch which might not have an associated .d.ts entry. both will break TS in sample apps.

maya: agreed. modern TS/node resolution supports a "types" entry per export so we should add it under every exported key. also ensure we ship the .d.ts files at those relative paths.

jordan: proposed minimal change to package.json: 
```json
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./runtime": {
    "types": "dist/runtime.d.ts",
    "import": "dist/runtime.mjs",
    "edge": "dist/edge.mjs"
  }
}
```

sam: that matches what I tried locally — after adding the per-entry "types" conditional and republishing locally (npm pack), the vite sample stopped showing the TS error.

lee: additional CI guardrails to prevent regressions:
- ensure packlist includes dist/**/*.d.ts
- add a node script that validates for every key in exports there is a corresponding types file path or top-level types fallback
- add a tiny tsc --noEmit check in sample-apps workflow so apps catch these fast

maya: FYI another gotcha: older consumers (node 12/14) that rely on "module" field may still pick the wrong entry. we should keep a top-level "module" only if necessary and document supported node versions. but mainly adding explicit exports/types solves the common cases.

ci-bot: lint-report: packlist missing dist/runtime.d.ts in v0.8.3 (detected by pack-scan job).

jordan: thanks CI bot. i'll add the packlist fix and a validation script to sdk repo. plan of attack:
1) change package.json exports to include types for all entries
2) update publish packlist to include all d.ts files
3) add tsc smoke test in sample-apps CI
4) add short troubleshooting blurb in quickstart docs (edge runtimes & TS)

sam: small note for support: common user steps that surface this are stale lockfile + package cache + old release that missed d.ts. recommend telling users to clear node_modules + lockfile and reinstall, and verify package version contains dist/*.d.ts.

lee: jordan, can you also add a small repro in the issue so we can link to it from support responses? quick repo with vite config + repro steps.

jordan: yup, creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/478 with tests and a failing sample-app run before the change, passing after. will request reviews from @sam and @maya.

ci-bot: release pipeline queued for v0.8.4 after PR merge.

maya: thanks everyone. this small export map detail causes outsized DX friction for newcomers on edge runtimes. glad we caught it.

sam: closing out — i'll update the onboarding checklist with a 1-line note and link to the docs blurb. if anyone hits stray cases after v0.8.4, paste `npm ls @redwood/inference` + `node -v` + `tsc --version` in the issue thread.

jordan: will follow up with the CI changes and link the support repro.

ci-bot: thread archived (auto).
